name: Pixel Frenzy
description:
About This Game

Wreak Havoc. Fire Away!

Go wild with destruction! In this pixel-style shooter, unleash devastating firepower to smash environments and enemies alike. Collect random upgrades and forge a unique combat build. Turn a fully destructible battlefield to your advantage: plan your tactics, invent your own way to fight, and face down pixel monsters invading reality!

Destroy Everything. Reshape the Battlefield!

The whole world is your battlefield. Walls, cover, floors—even the structure of entire levels—can be torn apart. Use destruction to reshape terrain and open new attack routes. Devise battle plans only you could pull off. Every act of destruction creates new possibilities!

Mix and Match. Create Your Own Build!

Combine guns, skills, and special modules however you like to create a combat style all your own. Enhance weapon traits, transform how you attack, and assemble radically different playstyles. There is no fixed formula—only the ultimate build that is uniquely yours!

Crush Mighty Foes. Tear Through Endless Hordes!

Every enemy has a unique form, attack pattern, and combat mechanic. From common and elite enemies to powerful bosses, every battle demands a different strategy. Identify and destroy their weak points to disable their attacks and leave them helpless! As pixel monsters swarm in, blast your way out with ever-growing firepower!

Explore! Smash Your Way to Hidden Surprises!

Feel destruction at its most satisfying! With unique 3D pixel-fragmentation effects, every shot and explosion hits just right. Level buildings, pulverize enemies, and trigger chain reactions—use outrageous firepower to tear the whole world apart! But remember: unexpected surprises lie hidden among the ruins. Break through walls, explore secret areas, and uncover treasures tucked away in the darkest corners of each environment. Destroy to forge new paths; explore to discover new possibilities!
short_desc: Pixel Frenzy is a fast-paced first-person shooter game where you create your own combat style in fully destructible environments. Defeat the pixel monsters invading the real world. Grab your weapon and save the world by destroying everything in your path!
